quotations: You can select a card discarded by the effect of "Monster Reincarnation" as a target of the effect of that same "Monster Reincarnation" (returning the monster to your hand).
notes: Goat Individual Card FAQ. Its loose phrase "by the effect" does not change discard from cost into an effect; current official text supplies cost semantics. Only target selection is borrowed, not adjacent Night Assailant/Makyura trigger rulings.
